vb_textbox.text: The strategy that worked for me was checking the two pairs of gnomes that kept alternating which color was more valuable at that point. When the gnome of that color started going below 4 points, I would switch to picking the other color of the gnome pairs. Ex. Purple/brown and green/red. If purple and red were giving me the best yield, I would keep picking purple and red until one of the colors met the above condition and switch to the other color.
